# Informativeness and sensitivity of the preregistered predictions

> SYNTHETIC: produced by a seeded software model in sim/. Not measured on any robot, sensor or receiver. The model and the method under test share an author. Evidence kind: simulated.

Generated from `sim/results_r3/` by `docsgen/facts.py`. A prediction is informative if its verdict changes under at least one mutant: M0 a monitor that never alarms, M1 one that alarms at the first chance, M2 each assumed parameter scaled by one half and by one and a half, M3 a shifted fault onset. This tests whether the earlier predictions could have failed; it does not make them true of a real robot.

## Summary

39 of 42 predictions are informative (their verdict changes under at least one mutant); 36 of those 39 hit, against 38 of 42 overall. Uninformative: H-P2, H-P3, N-P11. 177 mutants were run over 87 assumed parameters at the factors 0.5, 1.5.
